text: Gamification supplies quality control by making workers review and rate each other's contributions for points or recognition, which surfaces and resolves discrepancies through consensus-based voting or peer review rather than through duplicated independent work.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4755632

isBasedOn.name: AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning

abstract: Gamification can be utilized to improve data quality through mechanisms like consensus-based voting or peer review. Workers can review and rate each other's contributions, earning points or recognition for accurate and consistent work.
